entities.summary: Orsoy, from approximately 1273 to 1974 an independent town, most recently within the Kreis Moers district, is today a district and one of four boroughs of the North Rhine-Westphalian town of Rheinberg on the left bank of the Lower Rhine in the Kreis Wesel district.
